title: steris americana
intro: Steris americana, commonly known as American Ginseng, is a perennial plant native to the deciduous forests of North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries to promote overall health and well-being, with its health benefits including reducing stress, improving cognitive function, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Steris americana include acting as an adaptogen to help the body adapt to stress, improving sleep quality, and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ginsenosides, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other compounds such as polysaccharides and alkaloids.
